description: This Java class defines a custom exception called ExternalAssetOwnerNotFoundException, which extends a base exception for resource not found errors. It is used in the Fineract project to signal that an external asset owner could not be found based on external ID or internal ID.

classes.name: ExternalAssetOwnerNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that an external asset owner with a specific external ID or internal ID was not found in the system.

methods.name: ExternalAssetOwnerNotFoundException(ExternalId externalId)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message indicating that the external asset owner with the given external ID does not exist.

methods.name: ExternalAssetOwnerNotFoundException(Long id)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message indicating that the external asset owner with the given internal ID does not exist.
